info.description: API documentation for Siuji TOEFL exam application.
info.title: Siuji API

post.description: Change password for the currently authenticated user.
Request an OTP code to be sent to the registered email for password reset.
Authenticate user with email and password, returns access & refresh token.

get.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Set a new password after OTP verification. Requires a temp token (from verify-otp) in Authorization header.
Verify the OTP code sent to email. Requires a temp token (from forgot-password) in Authorization header.

get.description: Get periods the logged-in participant is registered for.

post.description: Can be called repeatedly while the exam is in progress — upserts by question.

get.description: Returns the final score, section breakdown, and certificate URL (generated on first request if passed).

post.description: Marks the exam as started and returns all sections/questions (without correct answers).
Finalizes the exam, computes section scores and the final TOEFL score.

get.description: Excel template with the required columns for bulk participant import. Admin only.
Get a paginated list of exam periods.

post.description: Create a new exam period with a certificate template image.

get.description: Get a period with its assigned sections.

put.description: Update a period. certificate_template is optional — omit to keep the existing one.

post.description: Creates the user account if the email doesn't exist yet. Password is auto-generated from NIM.
Columns (in order, header row skipped): Name, Email, NIM, University.

put.description: Partial update — only non-empty fields are applied. Changing NIM regenerates the password.

parameters.description: Ordered list of section public IDs
parameters.name: request

get.description: Get a question with its options and correct answer.

put.description: Update question text/passage. audio/image are optional — omit to keep the existing files.
Create or update the answer key. The option must belong to the given question.
put.summary: Set correct answer for a question

post.description: Create a new answer option for a question. Label (A, B, C, ...) is auto-derived from position.

put.description: Labels (A, B, C, ...) are automatically reassigned to match the new order.

parameters.description: Ordered list of option public IDs
parameters.name: request

parameters.description: Filter by listening, structure, or reading
parameters.name: section_type

post.description: Insert or update multiple entries at once, keyed by (section_type, correct_count).
Create a new section (question bank). section_type must be listening, structure, or reading.

get.description: Get a section with its questions, options, and correct answers.

post.description: Create a new question in a section. audio and image files are optional depending on section type.

parameters.description: Ordered list of question public IDs
parameters.name: request

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT access token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization

TempToken.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and temp JWT token.
TempToken.name: Authorization
